node Agent "agent / UI" role=external
node Mem "RdfMemory" role=process
node Store "QuadStore" role=process
node Sync "feed sync" role=process
node Shared "shared part" role=store
node Local "local part" role=store
node Log "facts feed" role=store
node Other "other devices" role=external
edge Agent -> Mem "put, query"
edge Mem -> Agent "facts, events"
edge Mem -> Store "batches, SPARQL"
edge Store -> Mem "rows"
edge Store -> Log "batch, first"
edge Log -> Store "batches in order"
edge Store -> Shared "facts, cursors"
edge Shared -> Store "quads"
edge Store -> Local "subs, outboxes"
edge Local -> Store "records"
edge Log -> Sync "blocks"
edge Sync -> Other "replicate"
